items.title: Jensen Huang faces DC grilling the same day Nvidia releases new products at GTC
items.author: CNBC
items.summary: Jensen Huang is back as CEO of Nvidia and immediately faces the challenge of leading the chip giant and defending himself in Washington.
items.content: Jensen Huang is back as CEO of Nvidia and immediately faces the challenge of leading the chip giant and defending himself in Washington.

items.title: Stocks give back gains as Anthropic dips below IPO price
items.summary: Hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by Barron's markets reporter Jacob Sonenshine, tackle the top stories of the day. Including futures sliding after Monday's biggest rally since April 2025, Anthropic briefly trading below its $83 IPO price, a Wall Street Journal report that the U.S. is preparing new tariffs on China and dozens of other countries, and whether Jensen Huang's return leaves Nvidia owing a favor to the White House. The team is joined by Seaport Research Partners senior analyst Jay Goldberg and Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin to discuss what Jensen Huang needs to tell shareholders, the competitive threat from Broadcom and AMD, and whether Nvidia's financing of neoclouds is a wobbly foundation. The show closes on Strategy trading below the value of its Bitcoin, Sanofi's $41 billion deal for Insmed, and a strong day for retail earnings from Best Buy, Dollar Tree, Dick's, Abercrombie, and Kohl's.

items.title: Who is holding Jensen Huang accountable? It sure looks like nobody
items.summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi digs into day two of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Including a Financial Times report that interim CEO Colette Kress was left out of the talks to bring Huang back, a Wall Street Journal report that Huang disclosed more affairs to the board than previously known, why Brian says Nvidia is effectively a "board of one," and what history says about returning founders from Steve Jobs and Howard Schultz to Kevin Plank.

items.title: Engen Consortium Outlines Plans for 1.9 GW Gas Power Station in Durban
items.summary: The Engen consortium, which includes ACWA Power, has outlined plans for a 1.9 GW combined cycle gas turbine power plant and LNG terminal in Durban, South Africa.
items.content: The Engen consortium, featuring ACWA Power, has detailed its strategy for the Durban LNG Import and Power Project. The initiative involves the development of a 1.9 GW combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power station and an associated LNG terminal at the former Engen refinery site in KwaZulu-Natal. The project aims to support industrial energy needs and gas-to-power procurement goals. Construction for the infrastructure is currently targeted to commence in 2028.

items.title: Shell plc Announces Transaction in Own Shares

items.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. announced strong third-quarter 2026 results, featuring $1.4 billion in net sales and adjusted earnings per share of $3.82, both exceeding analyst expectations.
items.content: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. reported net sales of $1.4 billion for the third quarter ended October 31, 2026, representing an 11% increase compared to the prior year, with comparable sales up 6%. The company achieved an operating income of $223 million and an operating margin of 15.5%, compared to 12.0% in the same period last year. Diluted earnings per share reached $3.82, significantly outperforming the FactSet consensus estimate of $3.08. Management attributed the performance to disciplined inventory management, strong gross margins, and operating expense leverage across both the Abercrombie and Hollister brands. Additionally, the company continued its capital return program, repurchasing 0.7 million shares during the quarter and 3.9 million shares year-to-date.

items.title: Cogent Biosciences Announces FDA Approval and Launch of EKITNA™ (bezuclastinib) for GIST
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved EKITNA™ (bezuclastinib) for the treatment of adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST) who have received prior treatment with imatinib.
items.content: Cogent Biosciences, Inc. announced that the FDA has approved EKITNA™ (bezuclastinib), a kinase inhibitor for adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST) previously treated with imatinib. This approval marks the first new treatment option in this setting in over 20 years and is based on positive results from the pivotal Phase 3 PEAK trial. In the trial, the combination of EKITNA and sunitinib demonstrated a statistically significant progression-free survival benefit compared to sunitinib monotherapy, with a median progression-free survival of 16.5 months and an objective response rate of 46%. The company has initiated the commercial launch of the drug in the U.S., supported by a patient assistance program called Cogent Connect™.

Management will attend the 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference in Coral Gables, Florida, on December 1, 2026, and the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference in New York, New York, on December 2, 2026. items.title: Cleveland-Cliffs Formally Opposes Proposed Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
items.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs has joined a coalition of manufacturers and labor unions in formally opposing the proposed $85 billion merger between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern.
items.content: Cleveland-Cliffs is among 57 additional parties that have formally filed opposition to the proposed $85 billion merger between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern with the Surface Transportation Board (STB). The company joins a growing coalition of major manufacturers, agricultural organizations, and labor unions concerned that the consolidation would lead to higher costs, reduced rail competition, and significant supply chain disruptions. This latest round of objections brings the total number of parties calling for the rejection of the merger to 97, with many others requesting strict conditions on any potential approval. The opposition highlights the strategic importance of rail logistics to Cleveland-Cliffs' operations as a vertically integrated steel producer.

items.title: Canada's Industry Minister Meets with Telecom CEOs on Connectivity and Resilience
items.summary: Canada's Industry Minister convened a meeting with major telecom CEOs, including those from TELUS, to address network resilience, competition, and connectivity.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Canada's Industry Minister held a meeting with the chief executive officers of major telecommunications companies, including TELUS Corporation. The discussions focused on critical industry topics such as network resilience, market competition, and the expansion of connectivity across the country. The meeting serves as part of the government's ongoing dialogue with the telecommunications sector regarding infrastructure and service standards.

The company will host a live conference call at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the same day to discuss the results. items.title: Applied Digital Completes Base-Build Commissioning and Achieves Ready for Service at Polaris Forge 2
items.summary: Applied Digital has completed the base-build commissioning for the first 75 MW of its Polaris Forge 2 data center in Harwood, North Dakota, and reached Ready for Service for the initial 25 MW.
items.content: Applied Digital announced the completion of base-build commissioning for the first 75 MW of its initial 150 MW data center building at the Polaris Forge 2 campus in Harwood, North Dakota. Within this phase, the company has successfully completed the integrated fit-out of the first 25 MW data hall and achieved Ready for Service status. This milestone reflects the company's ongoing execution of its strategy to deliver purpose-built AI infrastructure to hyperscale customers under long-term contracts. The facility is designed to support high-performance computing and AI workloads with advanced power and cooling capabilities.

items.title: Shoppa.ca Integrates Aeroplan Points for Canadian Marketplace Purchases
items.summary: Shoppa.ca has announced a partnership allowing customers to earn Aeroplan points on purchases made through its marketplace, powered by SnapPoints.
items.content: Shoppa.ca, a marketplace for verified Canadian-owned businesses, has launched a new loyalty integration enabling customers to earn Aeroplan points on their transactions. The program is facilitated by SnapPoints and aims to reward users for supporting Canadian businesses. Aeroplan members can utilize these points for various travel benefits, including flights on Air Canada with no blackout dates or surcharges, as well as hotel stays and merchandise through the Aeroplan eStore. This initiative is part of a broader effort to incentivize domestic shopping and expand the utility of the Aeroplan loyalty ecosystem.

The firm maintained its Buy rating on the shares. This adjustment reflects the latest analyst assessment of the company's market position and financial prospects.

items.title: Netskrt Highlights Partnership with Lumen Technologies in Series B Funding Announcement
items.summary: Netskrt, a provider of edge content delivery solutions, cited its ongoing partnership with Lumen Technologies as a key factor in its recent $10 million Series B funding round.
items.content: Netskrt announced the successful close of the first part of its Series B funding round, securing $10 million to accelerate its global growth. The company highlighted its partnership with Lumen Technologies, noting that the collaboration provides Netskrt with dynamic bare metal capacity to support its network expansion. This relationship offers Netskrt the flexibility required to meet delivery requirements across multiple regions. The funding will be used to further expand Netskrt's global deep edge footprint, building on its existing work in live sports streaming and infrastructure connectivity.

items.title: SPEA-Unifor 7474 Calls on AtkinsRéalis to Commit to Canadian Engineering for Future CANDU Projects
items.summary: The Society of Professional Engineers and Associates (SPEA-Unifor 7474) has publicly urged AtkinsRéalis to ensure that all engineering and design work for potential new CANDU nuclear builds in Ontario is performed within Canada.
items.content: The Society of Professional Engineers and Associates (SPEA-Unifor 7474) issued a statement endorsing CANDU technology for Ontario's upcoming nuclear energy projects. The union is calling on AtkinsRéalis to commit to keeping all engineering and design work for these projects in Canada, citing the need to support Canadian workers and intellectual property. The union argues that public funding for such projects should be contingent upon the majority of the supply chain being domestic. This appeal comes as the provincial government prepares to select reactor technology for future energy infrastructure.

items.title: Northrop Grumman Awarded $290.6 Million NASA Contract for SMBA Instruments
items.summary: Northrop Grumman has secured a $290.6 million contract from NASA to develop and support Sounder for Microwave-Based Applications (SMBA) instruments for NOAA satellites.
items.content: Northrop Grumman has been awarded a $290.6 million contract by NASA, acting on behalf of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), to provide design, development, production, testing, and mission support for three Sounder for Microwave-Based Applications (SMBA) instruments. These instruments are intended for use on NOAA's Near Earth Orbit Network satellites. The contract is a hybrid agreement incorporating cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, and time-and-materials structures. The project is scheduled to run from November 23, 2026, through April 1, 2042. NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center is managing the acquisition, while NOAA will own and operate the instruments.

items.title: Robinhood Included in Launch of OKXICE Tokenized Securities Venue
items.summary: Robinhood is among the companies whose shares are available for trading as tokenized assets on the newly launched OKXICE Tokenized Securities Venue.
items.content: Robinhood Markets, Inc. has been identified as one of the companies with tokenized shares available at the launch of the OKXICE Tokenized Securities Venue. The platform, a joint venture between Intercontinental Exchange and OKX, facilitates 24/7 onchain trading of tokenized U.S. securities. While the venue launched with 113 assets confirmed for a phased rollout, it faced significant pushback from other issuers, with 67 companies filing formal objections to prevent their shares from being tokenized on the platform. The launch follows an SEC Innovation Exemption, though some issuers cited the 30-day objection window as insufficient time to evaluate participation.

items.title: Xcel Energy Issues 2027 Earnings Guidance and Outlines Multi-Year Capital Plan
items.summary: Xcel Energy announced its 2027 ongoing earnings guidance and detailed a $70 billion capital expenditure plan for the 2027-2031 period.
items.content: Xcel Energy has issued its 2027 ongoing earnings guidance, projecting a range of $4.48 to $4.62 per share. As part of its long-term financial strategy, the company also outlined a $70 billion base capital expenditure plan spanning from 2027 through 2031. These projections are supported by an anticipated 5% increase in weather-normalized retail electric sales compared to 2026 levels. The company's planning framework focuses on meeting growing electricity demand, though it noted that these figures exclude potential incremental generation from future requests for proposals or additional transmission investments.

items.title: UnitedHealth Group Faces Market Pressure Following CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Proposal
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group shares experienced significant volatility following a regulatory proposal from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) regarding Medicare Advantage risk-adjustment data validation audits.
items.content: UnitedHealth Group and other major health insurers have faced downward pressure on their stock prices following a proposal by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) to extend risk-adjustment data validation (RADV) audits. The proposal, which allows CMS to recover overpayments dating back to 2018, has created uncertainty regarding the financial impact on Medicare Advantage plans. While some market commentary initially conflated this with changes to the Medicare Advantage "Star Ratings" program, the core issue involves the mechanism used to verify payment accuracy based on member health status. CMS has opened a 60-day public comment period for the proposal, which is scheduled to run through January 19, 2027.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Collaborates on Long-Term Sustainment Framework for AN/SPY-1 Radar
items.summary: Lockheed Martin is partnering with the U.S. Navy and other defense industry stakeholders to establish a performance-driven lifecycle support framework for the AN/SPY-1 radar system.
items.content: Lockheed Martin participated in a strategic alignment meeting with NAVSUP Weapon Systems Support and other naval commands to develop a new contracting framework for the AN/SPY-1 radar system. This enterprise initiative aims to create a performance-driven lifecycle support model designed to sustain the radar family through 2060. The effort is intended to bolster supply chain resilience and ensure long-term operational readiness for the fleet's surface combatants by integrating naval warfare centers, program executives, and industry partners.

items.title: FPT Long Châu Launches 'For Vietnamese Women – No More Fear of Cancer' Initiative
items.summary: FPT Long Châu has initiated a nationwide program to improve access to cancer education, screening, and care for women in Vietnam, including the donation of 3,000 complimentary screening packages.
items.content: FPT Long Châu, the pharmacy chain operated by FPT Digital Retail Joint Stock Company, has launched the 'For Vietnamese Women – No More Fear of Cancer' initiative. The program aims to expand access to cancer awareness, prevention, and clinical referral services across Vietnam. As part of the launch, FPT Long Châu committed to providing 3,000 complimentary health assessment and cancer-screening packages to health authorities in Ho Chi Minh City, Lam Dong Province, and Vinh Long Province. The initiative involves collaboration with public health authorities, the HOPE Foundation, Gene Solutions, and several pharmaceutical companies to create a connected healthcare pathway for women, particularly those in underserved communities.

items.summary: Chroma ATE Inc. has demonstrated strong market performance and order visibility extending into 2027, driven by demand for AI power, CPO, and system-level testing equipment.
items.content: Chroma ATE Inc. has emerged as a resilient performer in the Taiwan stock market, with its stock price showing strength despite broader market pullbacks. The company is benefiting from sustained demand for AI power, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), and system-level testing (SLT) equipment. Management reports that order visibility for certain business segments extends through the entirety of 2027. Specifically, the company has secured production orders for CPO equipment for the first quarter of next year, with plans to increase production capacity for third-station testing equipment to four to five times the current trial volume. Financial results for the first three quarters of 2026 show significant growth, with cumulative revenue reaching 43.315 billion TWD, a 120% year-over-year increase, and earnings per share (EPS) of 34.61 TWD, already surpassing the full-year results of 2025.

items.title: Tims China Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: TH International Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting revenue figures and store operational metrics.
items.content: TH International Limited, the master franchisee for Tim Hortons in China, announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total revenues of RMB 293.6 million (USD 43.8 million), representing an 18.0% decrease compared to the same period in 2025. System sales for the quarter were RMB 369.8 million (USD 55.2 million), an 11.9% decrease year-over-year. During the quarter, the company opened 66 new stores and closed 44 non-performing locations. Additionally, the company reported 38.2 million registered loyalty club members, marking a 37.0% increase from the previous year, and noted a flagship appearance at the 9th China International Import Expo in Shanghai.

items.title: Jyong Biotech Receives Letter of Intent for Botreso® Commercialization in the Philippines
items.summary: Jyong Biotech Ltd. announced that its subsidiary, Health Ever Bio-Tech Co., Ltd., has signed a non-binding letter of intent (LOI) with a Philippine enterprise to explore the potential introduction and commercialization of its investigational drug, Botreso®, in the Philippines.
items.content: Jyong Biotech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MENS) has received a non-binding letter of intent (LOI) from a Philippine medical enterprise to evaluate the regulatory pathway and commercialization strategies for its lead drug candidate, Botreso®, in the Philippines. Botreso® is a plant-derived oral therapy currently in development for the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and the prevention of prostate cancer. The company aims to leverage this potential partnership to expand its presence in the Southeast Asian market and address significant unmet medical needs associated with existing BPH treatments, which often suffer from high discontinuation rates due to side effects. The LOI is non-binding, and any definitive agreement remains subject to due diligence, clinical data evaluation, and regulatory requirements. Jyong Biotech continues to focus on building its BPH/LUTS portfolio while accelerating global development and out-licensing efforts.

items.title: ZJK Industrial Pauses Share Sales Under At-the-Market Equity Offering Program
items.summary: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. has decided to suspend its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program to avoid unnecessary shareholder dilution while maintaining financial flexibility.
items.content: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. announced on November 23, 2026, that it is pausing share sales under its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The company stated that this decision aims to prevent unnecessary dilution for existing shareholders while ensuring the firm maintains sufficient financial flexibility. Management expressed confidence in the company's ability to fund ongoing operations without utilizing the ATM program at this time. The company intends to retain the program as a potential financing option for future capital needs or if market conditions become more favorable. ZJK will continue to monitor its share price, liquidity, and alternative financing options to support its long-term strategic interests.

items.title: 51Talk Students Present Perspectives at UN Climate Change Conference (COP31)
items.summary: Nine young students supported by 51Talk participated in the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, to discuss climate change and sustainability.
items.content: On November 23, 2026, nine young participants from six countries—Türkiye, China, Indonesia, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Thailand—spoke at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye. Supported by 51Talk, the students shared their perspectives on environmental challenges and sustainability, highlighting the role of English communication in expressing ideas on an international stage. This event marks the fifth time 51Talk has facilitated student participation at a UN climate conference since 2019. The company also noted the recent introduction of its 'Global Communicator' curriculum, designed to help children apply language skills in real-world, cross-cultural situations.

items.title: CBAK Energy Ranks Fourth in China for Large Cylindrical Battery Shipments
items.summary: CBAK Energy Technology Limited announced it reached the fourth position in China for large cylindrical battery shipments during the first nine months of 2026, improving from its sixth-place ranking in 2025.
items.content: CBAK Energy Technology Limited reported that it ranked fourth in China for large cylindrical battery shipments in the first nine months of 2026, according to data from the Start Point Institute of Research (SPIR). This ranking is based on total energy capacity in gigawatt-hours (GWh) and represents an improvement from the company's sixth-place ranking for the full year of 2025. The company's current large cylindrical cell portfolio includes its 32140 FS and 40135 FS product families. Additionally, CBAK Energy announced plans to expand its annual cell production capacity at its Nanjing facility by 6 GWh by the end of 2026, which would increase the facility's total capacity to 10.5 GWh.

items.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Investigation into Global Mofy AI Limited
items.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has launched an investigation into Global Mofy AI Limited regarding potential securities fraud and shareholder dilution.
items.content: The Portnoy Law Firm is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Global Mofy AI Limited (NASDAQ: GMM) on behalf of investors. The inquiry focuses on whether the company and its officers issued misleading statements regarding its business practices. Specifically, the investigation examines the impact of repeated, deeply discounted equity financings, including a November 2026 offering of 45 million Class A shares at $0.22 per share, which allegedly caused severe shareholder dilution. Additionally, the firm is reviewing whether the company's acquisition of a stake in a CEO-controlled entity was properly valued and free from undisclosed conflicts of interest.

items.title: LightInTheBox Files Trademark Opposition Against K-pop Agency Ador
items.summary: LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd. has initiated a legal challenge with the US Patent and Trademark Office to block trademark applications filed by the K-pop agency Ador.
items.content: LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd. filed an opposition claim on November 16, 2026, with the Trademark Trial and Appeal Board of the US Patent and Trademark Office. The company is seeking to block two trademark applications filed by Ador, the agency behind the K-pop group NewJeans, which cover clothing and management services. LightInTheBox alleges that Ador deliberately chose its name to create an association with the retailer's own brand and claims it has been selling clothing under the 'Ador' name since at least 2018. The agency has until January 15, 2027, to respond to the opposition, with potential for a default judgment if it fails to do so.

items.title: Nasdaq Announces Delisting of YHN Acquisition I Limited
items.summary: Nasdaq has announced the formal delisting of the ordinary shares, units, and rights of YHN Acquisition I Limited following a prior suspension of trading.
items.content: On November 23, 2026, Nasdaq announced that it will delist the ordinary shares, units, and rights of YHN Acquisition I Limited. The company's securities had previously been suspended from trading on Nasdaq effective October 30, 2026. This action marks the formal removal of the company's securities from the exchange following the extended period of suspension.

items.title: The9 Limited Reschedules Annual General Meeting to December 24, 2026
items.summary: The9 Limited has announced the rescheduling of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) from December 4, 2026, to December 24, 2026, and the inclusion of additional proposals for shareholder approval.
items.content: The9 Limited announced that its Annual General Meeting (AGM), originally scheduled for December 4, 2026, has been moved to December 24, 2026. The meeting will be held at 10:00 a.m. (Hong Kong time) at the same previously announced venue. In addition to the original agenda, the company is adding new proposals for shareholder approval. This update follows the company's initial notice of the AGM issued on November 2, 2026.

items.title: Gamehaus Highlights Operational Milestones for Anamana Following Majority Stake Acquisition Agreement
items.summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc. reported significant growth for Anamana, an AI-native micro-serial platform, as it moves toward finalizing a majority stake acquisition.
items.content: Gamehaus Holdings Inc. announced strong operational and commercialization progress for Anamana, the AI-native micro-serial platform it has agreed to acquire. Between July 2026 and mid-November 2026, Anamana experienced a 15-fold increase in average daily aggregate gross bookings, rising from approximately $4,400 to $69,000. During the first 15 days of November 2026 alone, the platform surpassed $1 million in aggregate gross bookings, exceeding its full-month totals for both September and October. The acquisition of the majority stake is expected to close in November 2026, subject to customary conditions, with Gamehaus positioning Anamana as a core growth engine for its AI-native narrative entertainment strategy.

items.title: Gravity AI Expands Utility Bill Management Service with Integrated Payment Capabilities
items.summary: Gravity AI has enhanced its Utility Bill Management service by adding automated bill verification and payment processing features to help companies manage energy costs and emissions reporting.
items.content: Gravity AI has expanded its cloud-based Utility Bill Management service to include automated verification and payment capabilities. The platform now allows users to verify utility charges and execute payments directly, addressing the manual and fragmented nature of utility bill processing in many organizations. By integrating verification and payment into a single source of truth, the company aims to help clients identify billing errors, capture savings, and streamline emissions reporting. The service is designed to support companies across various sectors, including manufacturing and private equity, by providing insights that link energy spending with sustainability goals.

items.title: S&P Dow Jones Indices Announces Rebalancing Changes for S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600
items.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices, a division of S&P Global, announced index membership changes for the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600, effective December 2, 2026.
items.content: S&P Dow Jones Indices, a division of S&P Global, announced that SharkNinja Inc. will join the S&P 500, replacing AES Corp. Additionally, Paycom Software Inc. will move to the S&P MidCap 400, and Guardian Pharmacy Services Inc. will join the S&P SmallCap 600. These changes are scheduled to take effect prior to the opening of trading on Wednesday, December 2, 2026. The adjustments are part of the index provider's routine rebalancing process to reflect changes in market capitalization and corporate status among its constituents.

items.title: Lottomatica Shareholders Approve Merger with Blackstone-Backed CIRSA
items.summary: Shareholders of Lottomatica have approved a cross-border merger with CIRSA, a company controlled by Blackstone, which will result in Blackstone becoming the largest shareholder of the combined entity.
items.content: Lottomatica shareholders voted to approve the company's merger with CIRSA, a Spanish gaming operator backed by Blackstone. As part of the transaction, Blackstone, which currently acts as the controlling shareholder of CIRSA, is set to become the largest shareholder of the combined group with an approximate 24% stake. The agreement also includes the appointment of two new directors nominated by Blackstone-backed LHMC Midco. The merger is subject to regulatory and antitrust approvals and is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 2027.

items.title: HomesToLife Ltd. Reports Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: HomesToLife Ltd. announced its unaudited financial results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, reporting a 7% year-on-year revenue increase to US$295.6 million.
items.content: HomesToLife Ltd. reported net revenue of US$295.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, representing a 7% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company recorded a gross profit of US$79.3 million and a net income of US$3.5 million, with basic and diluted earnings per share of US$0.039. Financial results for the period reflect the inclusion of HTL Marketing Pte. Ltd. following its acquisition in May 2025. Despite a decline in operating income, the company maintains a solid liquidity position with US$20.3 million in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026. Management expects to maintain stable performance for the remainder of fiscal year 2026, consistent with its previously issued full-year revenue guidance of US$400 million to US$420 million.

items.title: Pfizer's Xeljanz Exempted from Medicare Price Negotiation Program
items.summary: Medicare has exempted Pfizer's arthritis treatment Xeljanz from its drug price negotiation program due to the presence of generic competition.
items.content: On November 23, 2026, the U.S. Medicare health plan announced that Pfizer's arthritis medication, Xeljanz, will be excluded from its maximum fair price negotiation program. The agency determined that the drug qualifies for an exemption because it currently faces generic competition in the marketplace. This decision follows the broader announcement of new, lower negotiated prices for 13 other high-cost drugs under the Inflation Reduction Act, which are set to take effect in 2028.

items.title: Tuya Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Declares Cash Dividend
items.summary: Tuya Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting total revenue of US$98.6 million and declaring a cash dividend.
items.content: Tuya Inc. reported total revenue of US$98.6 million for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 19.5% year-over-year increase from US$82.5 million in the same period of 2025. Platform-as-a-service (PaaS) revenue grew 18.3% to US$70.1 million. The company reported a net profit of US$18.5 million, up 23.8% from US$15.0 million in the third quarter of 2025, with a net margin of 18.8%. Basic and diluted net profit per ADS was US$0.03. Additionally, the company declared a cash dividend. As of September 30, 2026, Tuya held US$971.9 million in cash, cash equivalents, time deposits, and treasury securities.

items.title: Eli Lilly and Company to Present New Breast Cancer Portfolio Data at Upcoming Symposium
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Company announced that new data from its breast cancer portfolio will be presented at the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium in December 2026.
items.content: Eli Lilly and Company will feature new data from its breast cancer portfolio at the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium, scheduled for December 8–11, 2026. The presentation will cover research spanning early to advanced hormone receptor-positive (HR+) breast cancer. Lilly's portfolio focuses on three validated drivers of HR+ breast cancer: the estrogen receptor, CDK4/6, and PI3Kα.

items.title: Apple Plans Return of (PRODUCT)RED Lineup
items.summary: Apple is reportedly preparing to reintroduce (PRODUCT)RED versions of several existing hardware products and accessories, including the HomePod mini 2.
items.content: According to reports, Apple intends to expand its (PRODUCT)RED offerings by releasing red-colored variants of current products. The lineup is expected to include the HomePod mini 2, which would feature a red mesh exterior, and potentially other accessories. This move marks a return to the (PRODUCT)RED branding for Apple's hardware, following a period where the company had phased out such variants for its iPhone and Apple Watch models. The initiative represents a strategic update to the company's product aesthetics and charitable-linked branding efforts.

items.title: The Coca-Cola Company Appoints David Elkins as Incoming Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced that David Elkins will succeed John Murphy as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective April 2, 2027.
items.content: The Coca-Cola Company has named David Elkins as its incoming executive vice president and chief financial officer, with the transition scheduled for April 2, 2027. Elkins, who currently serves as the EVP and CFO of Bristol Myers Squibb, will succeed John Murphy, who has held the role since 2019. Murphy will continue to serve as president, focusing on key enterprise priorities throughout 2027 to ensure a smooth leadership transition. CEO Henrique Braun noted that Elkins brings extensive experience from global pharmaceutical and consumer products companies to the leadership team. As CFO, Elkins will oversee finance, global strategy, and Enterprise Services.

items.title: Emerging Growth Research Releases Q3:26 Quarterly Update on SBC Medical Group

items.content: The Q3:26 update highlights that SBC Medical Group's revenue grew approximately 35% year-over-year to $58.6 million, while operating profit increased by 66% to $26.4 million. The company reported an EPS of $0.15 and expanded its clinic network to 293 locations, an increase of 36 locations year-over-year. Management attributes the performance to recovery from 2025 franchising fee reductions, the integration of Waqoo operations, and continued network expansion. The report also notes that AI initiatives are expected to contribute up to $15 million in additional annualized revenue over the coming year.

items.title: Roze AI Signs Non-Binding Memorandum of Agreement to Explore Potential Acquisition of Shares in BAUM Architects
items.summary: Roze AI Inc. has entered into a non-binding memorandum of agreement with South Korean architectural design firm BAUM Architects to explore a potential equity acquisition and strategic cooperation.
items.content: Roze AI Inc. announced on November 23, 2026, that it signed a non-binding memorandum of agreement (MOA) on November 20, 2026, with BAUM Architects Co., Ltd. The agreement aims to explore a potential acquisition of shares in the architectural design firm and to pursue related strategic cooperation. The parties intend to engage in good-faith negotiations to align Roze AI's fire safety technology with BAUM Architects' design capabilities. Specific transaction details, such as the equity stake, purchase price, and timeline, remain subject to future definitive agreements, due diligence, and regulatory approvals. The MOA is non-binding, except for confidentiality provisions, and is set to terminate after six months unless extended or replaced by a definitive agreement.

items.title: BlackRock European Absolute Return Fund to Rebrand as BlackRock European Growth & Dividend Trust
items.summary: The investment fund is set to undergo a name change to BlackRock European Growth & Dividend Trust in December 2026 as part of a strategic shift.
items.content: The fund, currently known as the BlackRock European Absolute Return Fund, will be renamed the BlackRock European Growth & Dividend Trust in December 2026. This transition is accompanied by an enhanced dividend policy targeting 4.5% of net asset value (NAV) per year. The fund is also adopting a more active approach to gearing and introducing a five-yearly performance-conditional tender opportunity to improve its appeal. Under new lead manager Benjamin Moore, the fund's portfolio has been reshaped to balance global and domestic, as well as 'old' and 'new' economy assets.

items.title: Uber Pilots "Record My Ride" Feature in Select U.S. Cities
items.summary: Uber has launched a pilot program for a "Record My Ride" feature in Baltimore, Raleigh, Indianapolis, and St. Louis, allowing drivers to record trips using their phone's front camera.
items.content: The pilot program, branded as "Recorded Rides," utilizes the driver's front-facing camera to record the entire trip. The feature is being tested for late-night bookings and trips involving teenagers, with automatic activation if the app detects an accident or the vehicle going off-course. Drivers retain the ability to opt out of the recording feature through their settings, and riders can decline permission via an in-app notification.

items.title: Citi Lowers Price Target on Salesforce
items.summary: Citi's research team reduced its price target for Salesforce stock, citing concerns over sluggish demand and weakened sales pipelines.
items.content: Citi analyst Tyler Radke issued a research note lowering the price target for Salesforce (CRM) to $198, while maintaining a "Neutral" rating. The adjustment follows checks with customers and partners that indicated a slowdown in demand for the company's core software and a trend toward shorter contract lengths. The report highlights that these factors could make future revenue more difficult to predict and notes that while there is some momentum in newer AI-focused products, widespread adoption remains uneven.

items.title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
items.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.

items.title: CrowdStrike Shares Fall 10% After a $44 Billion Zscaler Deal Despite an Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
items.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., explains why shares of CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 10% on Monday, November 23, while most tech stocks rallied. The trigger was a proposed acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) for about $44 billion, announced the same morning. The sell-off came despite a strong report. CrowdStrike posted revenue growth of 28.3% against expectations of 23.9%, and EPS of $0.34 against $0.31. It also raised full-year guidance. Bleeker points to the deal instead: Zscaler's wide product line may be hard to integrate into CrowdStrike's platform, and the roughly 34% premium arrives when cybersecurity stocks are richly valued. Zscaler shares rose about 16%, while CrowdStrike is now down 26% from its recent highs. Bleeker lays out both cases. The bull case is that cybersecurity budgets must rise as companies patch systems, with outages at Apple and others as examples. The bear case is that frontier AI models may become the center of cyber defense, which raises questions about what companies like CrowdStrike offer. Expect choppy trading in these shares while investors sort that out.

The S&P 500 was up about 4.5% in midday trading, after news broke that Jensen Huang will return as CEO of NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA). The IT sector gained 8.6%, while financials rose 1.7%, utilities 0.96% and health care 0.9%. Real estate and energy declined. The State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA: SPY) rose about 4.5%. Chips drove the move. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ: SOXX) gained 12.9%, led by NVIDIA, which was up more than 30%. The iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (Cboe: IGV) rose about 4%, so software stocks reacted far less than chip stocks. The GraniteShares 2x Long NVIDIA Daily ETF (NASDAQ: NVDL) jumped 60% but is still down nearly 50% over the past month. NVIDIA traded around $180 before Huang's ouster and hasn't recovered that level. Many stocks bouncing 20% or more today fell 20% or more at the end of last week. Watch whether this is a relief rally or the start of a recovery after the market rotated out of AI and into defensive sectors.

Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa also joins to break down Silicon Valley's reaction to Huang's return and what it means for the AI trade.

items.title: Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO after 12 days: Shares surge 30%
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the stunning news of the morning: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstating founder Jensen Huang as CEO just 12 days after his resignation. Including his five takeaways on what the reversal says about corporate governance, the role Washington played in the decision, and the rally that's lifting the whole AI trade while sending AMD lower. Brian is joined by New Street Research technology infrastructure analyst Antoine Chkaiban on the new checks around Huang and why he's still a buyer; "In the Loop" host Ejaz on key-man risk and whether the "Bank of Nvidia" reopens for neoclouds; EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson, who calls the return a win for open-source AI; Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman on the board's credibility and Colette Kress's future; Moor Insights & Strategy founder and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead on the politics behind the ouster and why nothing changes for AMD for 18 months; and SlateStone Wealth partner and chief market strategist Kenny Polcari on whether this kicks off a year-end rally.
